item.title: Toyota claims new RAV4 PHEV has ‘world-leading’ efficiency with 58% more electric range
item.description: The new Toyota RAV4 plug-in hybrid (PHEV) now delivers up to 150 km (93 miles) of electric range, 58% more than the outgoing version. more…

item.title: This New York pump station ditched diesel for battery backup
item.description: A wastewater pumping station in Erie County, New York, is now running backup power on a battery storage system instead of a diesel generator, and local officials say it could cut costs, emissions, and maintenance headaches. more…

item.title: Slate pricing to be revealed in June, ‘Blank Slate’ truck still expected in the mid-$20k range
item.description: EV newcomer Slate Auto just shared an interesting new video on its social media, setting the stage to reveal pricing of its flagship “Blank Slate” electric pickup in June. From what the American startup is saying, it sounds like the bare-bones model will still be one of the most affordable EVs on the market. more…

item.title: BYD reveals a new low-cost EV with 375 miles range, but this one will be unique
item.description: BYD revealed the first vehicle under its new Linghui sub-brand. The Linghui e9 is an all-electric sedan with a cruising range of 375 miles (605 km), but BYD’s latest EV is aimed at a new market. more…

item.title: Biggest study yet shows plug-in hybrids use over 300% more fuel than claimed
item.description: The largest real-world study yet, accounting for nearly a million plug-in hybrid vehicles, shows that PEVs use far more gasoline than previously claimed. The study comes just as Europe is about to change PHEV regulations, with industry lobbying to maintain the current highly inaccurate numbers. more…

item.title: Tesla launches $60k AWD Cybertruck, reverses $15k Cyberbeast price hike
item.description: Tesla is now selling a base model all-wheel drive Cybertruck starting at $60k, and has cut the price of its top-end Cyberbeast model to $100k, down from $115k. The move comes as the company struggles to sell the controversial truck, which has heretofore never come close to meeting its projected volume. more…
